headline: Strong Q2; poised to outperform FY27 guidance

highlights: Defence revenue rose to ~INR10bn in Q2FY27, contributing 29% of revenue, while the defence order book stood at ~INR175.7bn within the overall order book of INR201.8bn, providing robust medium-term growth visibility.
Management expects to surpass FY27 revenue guidance of ~INR140bn and defence revenue guidance of ~INR45bn, with EBITDA margin likely to exceed 29% versus the earlier ~28% guidance.

Domestic explosives are poised for sustained growth, supported by healthy mining and infrastructure demand, capacity expansion and management’s volume growth target of 10-15% (vs industry growth of 6-7%).
In defence, the ~INR3bn Guided Pinaka order is expected to be concluded before FY27-end, taking the total Pinaka-family opportunity to ~INR9bn.
valuation: Domestic explosives are poised for sustained growth, supported by healthy mining and infrastructure demand, capacity expansion and management’s volume growth target of 10-15% (vs industry growth of 6-7%).

Bhargavastra trials are targeted for completion by CY26-end, paving the way for commercialisation, while increasing traction across 155mm ammunition and missile programs provides additional growth avenues.

Explosive Domestic: • Domestic explosives business delivered healthy growth despite the monsoon season, supported by mining and infrastructure demand. • Lower-than-average monsoon conditions across mining regions supported demand during Q2FY27, while management expects stronger momentum in H2FY27. • Management targets annual domestic volume growth of ~10–15%, against industry growth of ~6–7%.
